name: Mehemmedeli Osmanli
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: An Azerbaijani bantamweight (11-2, age 22) and TUF 34 finalist who lost the final to Ilimbek Akylbek Uulu by disqualification for an illegal knee, a finish many saw as controversial. He had won nine straight before that.

how_they_fight.Grappling: A submission grappler: six submissions, finishes in R1, R2, R3 and R5.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Can finish late, including a R5 submission.

patterns: Submissions in later rounds as well as early

news.text: Booked for his UFC debut against Pavel Andrusca despite the TUF 34 final loss.

sources.author: Sayan Nag
sources.title: Mehemmedali Osmanli reportedly books UFC debut despite 'TUF 34' loss
